result_text:
The landscape contributor lists and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles and its tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test`, no output, so no failures).

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `limit` variable, the `.limit(limit)` call, and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. Sorting is unchanged, so most recent commits still come first.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`**: `getBarsHtml` now iterates all recently active contributors, so the bar chart has one bar per contributor.

I left `LandscapeConfiguration` alone, so `contributorsListLimit` is still in the config and its getter still exists, though nothing reads it now. I did not add a test for the untruncated output, and I did not run a landscape report end to end. The unrelated `MAX_CONTRIBUTOR_LIST_SIZE` cap in `ContributorsReportUtils.java` (non-landscape report) is untouched. Nothing was committed.
